title: Pixel Reasoner: Incentivizing Pixel-Space Reasoning via Curiosity-Driven Reinforcement Learning

Q1.quote: 5 Experiments In this section, we first outline the training and evaluation settings.

Q3.quote: For Instruction Tuning, we use a batch size of 128. The learning rate is 1e−6 with 10% warm up steps. For RL, we set employ a cosine learning rate schedule with initial learning rate 1e−6 and 3% warm up iterations. During RL training, we sample 8 trajectories per training query and set hyperparameters to α = 0.5, β = 0.05, H = 0.3, and N = 1.
